messages:
jana: billing ops flagged a bump in 'org-unknown' usage this morning, looks like sidecar sometimes omits X-Org-Id when proxied via edge-rewrite.
mike: can you repro?
jana: yes in staging with /v1/stream through edge rewrite. sidecar log: 
``
WARN sidecar: auth exchange failed err=ERR_EXCHANGE_TIMEOUT deadline=50ms
```
kai: our sidecar uses a single sync exchange 50ms deadline, no retries. multi-hop increases latency.
mike: options: raise timeout (p99 risk) or fallback local decode + cache. prefer best-effort fallback and mark confidence.
jana: proposed fallback flow: 1) cached token-hash->org lookup, 2) local JWT decode for stable claims, 3) if still unknown set X-Attribution: unattributed and X-Attribution-Source: fallback_unattributed. emit metric with reason.
edge-proxy-bot: FYI double-proxy adds ~8ms. edge team open to RFC for direct edge->auth for hot paths.
kai: telemetry: auth.sidecar.exchange.{success,timeout,4xx}, auth.sidecar.decode.local_success, auth.sidecar.attribution.fallback. tags: env, route, org.
mike: console UX: show Attribution Confidence pill on per-org usage card explaining sources. reduces support noise.
jana: rollout: enable FEATURE_SIDECAR_EXCHANGE_RETRIES=2 for 5% canary orgs, monitor fallback rate, then ramp. PR incoming.
infra-bot: deploy queued: svc-sidecar@canary started by jana (build d3f2).
jana: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sidecar/pull/305 - retry + fallback + metric hooks. pinging @mike @kai for review.
infra-bot: deploy success: svc-sidecar@canary d3f2 -> instances healthy
mike: policy: do not retry on auth-service 4xx (invalid tokens). retry only on timeouts/5xx with small backoff.
kai: add 1% sampled trace for fallback cases with request_id and token_hash, no token payload. alert if fallback rate >0.5% over 5m.
jana: monitoring canary now, will report back billing parity. :thumbsup:
